title: FloodGuard Fee and Billing Plan Schedule
content:
Billing department schedule for the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy: the annual policy fee, the billing plans each tier allows, the service charges, the smallest refundable credit and how far ahead a renewal is billed.

| Tier | Annual policy fee (USD) | Billing plans allowed | Two-pay installment fee (USD) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Refund minimum (USD) | Renewal billed or invoiced ahead of expiration (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 45.00 | Annual; mortgagee escrow | 0.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 60 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 50.00 | Annual; mortgagee escrow | 0.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 60 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 50.00 | Annual; mortgagee escrow | 0.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 60 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 75.00 | Annual; two-pay; mortgagee escrow | 8.00 | 25.00 | 5.00 | 60 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 75.00 | Annual; two-pay; mortgagee escrow | 8.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 60 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 100.00 | Annual; two-pay; mortgagee escrow | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | 5.00 | 60 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The **policy fee** is annual and fully earned when billed.
- The **two-pay installment fee** is the service charge on the second installment of the two-pay plan. The two-pay plan is available on FloodGuard Plus, Premier and High Value only; on FloodGuard High Value it carries no service charge.
- The **returned payment fee** is charged per returned payment; 0.00 means none, as on FloodGuard High Value.
- The **refund minimum** is the smallest credit balance refunded, 5.00 USD on every tier.
- A renewal is billed or invoiced **60 calendar days** before expiration on every tier.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a hypothetical FloodGuard Plus policy expiring on 30 September, the renewal is billed or invoiced on 1 August, 60 calendar days earlier. A FloodGuard Standard policyholder cannot be placed on the two-pay plan, because that tier allows only the annual and mortgagee escrow plans.
